fact: The Bank of Sierra Leone's supervision head told the ITU workshop of 1 July 2025 that 8 fintechs operate under full BSL licences, 19 are in its sandbox, and Mobile Money Regulations 2024 are yet to be finalized.
title: Deep Dive on Quality Assessment of DFS - A Regulatory Perspective
publisher: Bank of Sierra Leone (ITU Workshop on Telecommunication Service Quality)
